_about: The labs page (labs.html), for grown-ups: the games it can start, by the id of their settings file in data/games/ and the name shown. A new game is offered here once its settings file is in. moments: the word moments it can play by themselves, by the id of their file in data/moments/. labs: where a round can start instead of its beginning (index.html?lab=<id>), with the game, level and player chosen; wrong-order: the cooking with every dish made and poured, the first order wrong in every way its card allows, straight into the wrong-order pop-up (js/kitchen/lab.rules.js; Zafar, 21 Nov: 'a quick lab page section for just wrong orders').
